summary: Lower an ordinary function declaration to a C# local/static function only when declaration-instantiation semantics are resolved and JS function-object behavior is unobservable.

target.notes: C# local functions may be referenced before their textual declaration, matching the useful hoisting property after JS declaration-instantiation conflicts have been resolved.

semantics.binding_creation: function binding exists before statement execution in its scope
semantics.constructable: ordinary functions may be constructable unless syntax form says otherwise

caveats: Global-script declarations and Annex B block-function rules need separate environment handling.
The function object itself has observable properties (name, length, prototype).

tests.name: call before declaration
tests.expected_csharp: static double add(double a, double b) => a + b; Console.WriteLine(add(2d, 3d));
